messages:
eva: heads-up — starting the staged v2 rollout at 15:00 PT in 30m. change window 2h. plan: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% (20m increments). we'll use header gate `x-redwood-api-version` and route-level pinning for mobile. monitor errors, p99 latency, and token cost delta.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: v2-staged-rollout by eva at 1965123456. steps created: step-1(1%), step-2(5%), step-3(20%), step-4(50%), step-5(100%). healthchecks: smoke, synth-queries, embeddings-sanity.

kevin: quick q — can we keep mobile clients pinned to v1 for at least first two steps? older SDKs might not set the header consistently.

nick: +1 to pin mobile. we can apply a route-level override: client-type header mapping -> v1. quick config: 
```
route: /api/generate
overrides:
  - match: header x-client-type: mobile
    target: v1
    ttl: 2h
```
I'll push the override if evA approves.

eva: approve nick to push pin for mobile for the first 40m. keep logs and a metric tag `pinned_mobile:true`.

sara: QA will run the regression suite on step-1 canary (1%) and the 5% cohort as soon as deployed. i'll post failures in this thread. smoke checklist: latency runbook, prompt-regression set A1, payment flow check.

ops-bot: alerting note — created dashboard `v2-rollout/stage` and two alerts: `v2.error_rate > 3% (5m)` and `v2.p99_increase > 150ms (10m)`. paging to oncall if either fires.

kevin: one more ask — add release notes snippet for breaking header behavior so client teams get an email. small copy: "If you don't send `x-redwood-api-version: v2`, you'll continue hitting v1. Older mobile SDKs may need update to opt into v2."

deploy-bot: step-1 (1%) started at 1965123480. running healthchecks.

nick: pushed mobile pin override. config diff: +override for x-client-type: mobile -> v1.

sara: smoke pass on canary at 1%. no obvious regressions. p50 latency +10ms, p99 +30ms. posting logs to the dashboard.

deploy-bot: step-2 (5%) started at 1965123500.

eva: monitoring closely. if error rate > 3% or p99 increases > 120ms we pause and roll back. also ready to abort mobile pin only if traffic stable.

ops-bot: detected a 4.5% error spike in europe cluster at 5% step; alert triggered. paging oncall.

kevin: seeing increased 429s for a subset of requests that include large prompt batches. could be batching kernel on the new runtime. rolling back those route variants might help.

eva: pause rollout. deploy-bot pause command issued. hold traffic at 0% for remaining steps.

deploy-bot: rollout paused at 5% by eva at 1965123512. ongoing mitigation: revert route kernel tweaks for large-batch-path and re-add fallback to v1 for sequences > 1024.

nick: initiating rollback for Europe cluster to v1 for the affected routes. will keep mobile pin in place until we confirm baseline stability.

sara: running targeted regression on the large-batch flows. i'll update in 15m.

eva: decision: we will not fully roll forward today. keep rollout paused, publish interim release notes and a short customer advisory. we'll reconvene in 2 hours for a follow-up decision. thanks team. :thumbsup:
